description: Version-controlled Directus extension manifest. Lists every endpoint and bundle that QA, build and release must discover, test and package. Tools iterate this list rather than hard-coding extension names.

extensions.name: vibetable-bulk-mutation
extensions.description: Atomic server-side bulk mutation endpoint with idempotency keys and permission enforcement.

extensions.name: vibetable-workspace-index
extensions.description: Workspace index endpoint: idempotent document registration/import, revision publish, link/unlink, and expected-head CAS reconcile.

extensions.name: vibetable-plugin-bridge
extensions.description: Shared confirm/progress operations and authenticated runtime bridge for VibeTable plugin tasks.

extensions.name: vibetable-lookup-query
extensions.description: Permission-aware frontier-batched execution of strongly typed virtual Lookup fields over complete datasets.
